headline: Monday morning, Day 219, T+8 on the Aug 9 launch, and the shape of the week is now unmistakable. Aug 15's single on-cron morning was followed by four broken editions in a row: Aug 15 PM never ran, Aug 16 AM generated a skeleton it never shipped, Aug 16 PM shipped only because a session drove it by hand, and Aug 17 AM then dropped entirely — no generator, no sweep, no draft. This PM is again a recovery driven by hand, which is the whole problem in one sentence: the only briefs reaching you are the ones a human session pushes. Underneath the machine the real number has not moved a millimetre. A live PM read of the mailbox runs from:facebookmail.com OR from:meta.com across the whole account and comes back EMPTY — no ad review, no billing receipt, no lead, eight days past T-0. Zero IRS at 50 days, zero Mercedes at 38. The one thing that DID move is the wrong thing: the 'Chitraksh to VC USA' phantom — the automated VC-connect sequence Meeting 38 said should not exist — woke up and auto-fired again at 13:07Z today, died on the same invalid cookie, and paused itself. So the 'quiet six days' the last brief called auto-paused is now proven: it is not resting, it resumes the instant it can. W15 — launched, or held to a named date — is now five mornings unwritten, and the last founder decision recorded anywhere in this company is still Aug 5, twelve days ago. Every gate on this board is still waiting on one sentence nobody has written down.
